item.title: v0.5.1
item.description:
What's new

  • Sign in with Google. When your Control Plane signs people in with Google, Add account offers "Sign in with Google": one sign-in links this computer. A Control Plane without Google works as before.
  • The Control Plane page signs itself in. The Control Plane inside the app opens already signed in to your account, with no second sign-in.

Fixed

  • The usage panel scrolls. The top (Connected, Pause) and the bottom stay; a long list of credentials scrolls in between, and the panel never runs off the screen.
  • Resets say the time left, like 1D3H or 24M, and count down while the panel is open.
  • Only the windows in use. Windows at 0 % are left out, a credential not used yet says so, and windows are named as you know them (5h, 7d, Fable 7d, Opus 7d, Spend…).
